media.title: Western Mediterranean Operations Area
media.caption: AIS tracking and VTMS systems monitoring nominal traffic.

messages.content: Simultaneous OT System Failure — Port Marseille-Fos. SCADA system controlling Terminal J cranes frozen. MV Olympia with IMO Class 3 hazardous cargo immobilized at Quay J4. Remote connection from IPs in Romania and UAE.
CROSS Med reports MV Silver Horizon disabled AIS transponder for 47 minutes last night, near the SEA-ME-WE 5 submarine cable landing point.
SENTINEL v3.2 correlation alert: 3 similar incidents in past 72 hours (Port of Genoa, Tanger Med, Valencia). Consistent with APT-POSEIDON. Recommendation: MARSEC CYBER ALPHA.

questions.question: [QUIZ] MARITIME CERT — IMMEDIATE RESPONSE DECISION (D-01)

options.label: A → Immediately isolate OT from IT networks (segmentation)
B → Maintain connectivity to trace attacker in real time
C → Alert port authorities first — await confirmation
D → Activate BCP — switch to manual degraded mode

questions.note: OT/IT isolation limits lateral movement, preserves forensic integrity. switch to manual BCP mode ensures safety.

questions.question: [QUIZ] PORT AUTHORITY — EMERGENCY DOCKING DIRECTIVE

options.label: A → Command the vessel to drop anchor immediately in the approach channel
B → Authorise emergency tug boarding and manual override mooring
C → Order vessel to return to open sea to clear the harbor entrance
D → Keep the vessel at Quay J4 and wait for auxiliary generator boot

questions.note: Tug assistance with manual mooring prevents channel obstruction and quay impact during power failures.

questions.question: [QUIZ] SECURITY CELL — VTMS TRACK VERIFICATION

options.label: A → Cross-reference tracks using optical/thermal surveillance cameras
B → Reboot VTMS radar servers immediately to clear cached state
C → Rely entirely on transponder reports from vessels in area
D → Suspend all port traffic until GPS signals normalize

questions.note: Visual/optical confirmation is the ultimate out-of-band truth verification when digital sensors conflict.

questions.question: [QUIZ] CERT LEAD — PLC FIRMWARE ANOMALY

options.label: A → Execute clean firmware re-flash from an offline gold image
B → Ignore the alert as a false positive from routine updates
C → Perform a live memory dump of active PLCs over the network
D → Power-cycle the PLCs to clear volatile memory

questions.note: Firmware re-flash from validated offline media is the only reliable way to clear hardware-level implants.

questions.question: [VOTE] STRATEGIC VOTE — CRISIS COMMAND LEADERSHIP

options.label: A → Port Authority (operational focus)
options.note: Ensures commerce flow but lacks security resources

options.label: B → Military Joint Command (sovereignty focus)
options.note: Strong assets but civilian friction potential

options.label: C → Inter-ministerial Crisis Cell (policy focus)
options.note: Optimal for strategic and national coordination

options.label: D → Private terminal operators (business focus)
options.note: Severe conflict of interest in crisis command

questions.note: Inter-ministerial crisis cells balance public safety, military intelligence, and economic sovereignty.

questions.question: [VOTE] STRATEGIC VOTE — PUBLIC INFORMATION POSTURE

options.label: A → Complete blackout: deny any cyber incident
B → Confirm minor technical issues — scenario under control
options.note: Buys time but risks appearing dismissive

options.label: C → Factual confirmation of cyber disruption — no attribution details
options.note: Maintains trust without releasing sensitive data

options.label: D → Accuse hostile state actors immediately to preempt media speculation
options.note: Dangerous escalatory move without full evidence

questions.note: Sovereign communication must remain factual, avoiding premature attribution to protect sources.

questions.question: [VOTE] STRATEGIC VOTE — HARBOR SUSPENSION

options.label: A → Yes: Full commercial shut-down to preserve digital forensic state
B → No: Keep unaffected terminals open under visual observation
options.note: Balances security risks with regional economic survival

options.label: C → Delegate the decision to individual shipping companies
options.note: Abdication of authority during national crisis

questions.note: Keeping commercial operations active under out-of-band surveillance mitigates economic paralysis.

questions.question: [OPEN] OPEN SITREP — CIVILIAN-MILITARY COMMAND TRANSITIONS
questions.prompt: Identify the primary strategic gap between the Port's emergency response plan and the Navy's rules of engagement.

questions.question: [OPEN] OPEN SITREP — UNILATERAL VESSEL REDIRECTION
questions.prompt: What legal authority permits the unilateral redirection of commercial vessels in the exclusive economic zone during a suspected cyber incident?

questions.question: [OPEN] OPEN SITREP — ECONOMIC IMPACT MITIGATION
questions.prompt: How will your role group mitigate the supply-chain ripple effect of a 12-hour complete shutdown of Marseille-Fos terminal operations?
